# The standard library must be imported. Built-ins are the one exception: they
# are dot-imported into every file implicitly, which is the only such magic.
! sngl check nostd.sngl
stderr 'undefined: text'

sngl check withstd.sngl
stdout 'withstd.sngl: ok'

# Built-ins need no import — types, their methods, and literals all resolve.
sngl check builtins.sngl
stdout 'builtins.sngl: ok'

# And cannot be imported: naming an ambient package would imply it were
# optional.
! sngl check importbuiltin.sngl
stderr 'always in scope'

# The alias form binds the same package under a name of the caller's choosing.
sngl check aliased.sngl
stdout 'aliased.sngl: ok'

# Lowercase stdlib components stay reachable through the alias in expression
# position too. The private-component filter that rejects lowercase names in an
# imported package must recognise the stdlib by package identity — keying it on
# the name "sngl" rejects every other alias here.
sngl check aliased_expr.sngl
stdout 'aliased_expr.sngl: ok'

# A target's package is reached by importing it, like any other -- raw platform
# elements included. They used to be ambient for every registered platform, so
# `html.marquee` resolved in a file that named nothing, and a misspelling
# reached the element wildcard of a package the program never asked for.
sngl check rawelem.sngl
stdout 'rawelem.sngl: ok'

# Without the import the name is not in scope at all. html is the one whose
# name the stdlib also declares (for html.frontend/html.backend), so there the
# namespace resolves and the member is what is missing; every other platform
# fails on the namespace.
! sngl check rawelem_unimported.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "gtk4.GtkLabel"'

# That filter still applies to a real user package.
! sngl check private.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "helper" in package w'

# The shapes are their own package. std no longer declares them, so a name an
# application wants for itself -- rect, line, path -- is free unless the file
# asks for sngl:draw.
! sngl check draw_unimported.sngl
stderr 'unknown component "canvas"; sngl:draw declares it'

sngl check draw_imported.sngl
stdout 'draw_imported.sngl: ok'

# std and draw dot-imported together do not collide.
sngl check draw_both_dotted.sngl
stdout 'draw_both_dotted.sngl: ok'

# Without draw, the names are the file's own to use.
sngl check draw_names_free.sngl
stdout 'draw_names_free.sngl: ok'

-- nostd.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- withstd.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- builtins.sngl --
component main {
    var n int = int.max(1, 2)
    var f float = float.sqrt(2.0)
    var s string = string.upper("hi")
    var c color = color.rgb(1, 2, 3)
    var d date = "2026-08-21"
}
-- importbuiltin.sngl --
import . "sngl:builtin"

component main {
    var n int = 1
}
-- rawelem.sngl --
import "sngl:platforms/html"
import "sngl:platforms/gtk4"

component Foo() {
    html.marquee() {}
}

component Bar() {
    gtk4.GtkLabel(label="x") {}
}
-- rawelem_unimported.sngl --
component Bar() {
    gtk4.GtkLabel(label="x") {}
}
-- aliased_expr.sngl --
import ui "sngl:std"

func render() => ui.text(value="x")

component main {
    ui.text(value="y")
}
-- private.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import w "widgets"

func render() => w.helper()

component main {
    text(value="x")
}
-- widgets/widgets.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component helper() {
    text(value="private")
}
-- aliased.sngl --
import ui "sngl:std"

component main {
    ui.text(value="x")
}
-- draw_unimported.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component main {
    canvas(width=100px, height=100px) {}
}
-- draw_imported.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import d "sngl:draw"

component main {
    d.canvas(width=100px, height=100px) {
        d.circle(cx=5.0, cy=5.0, r=2.0)
    }
}
-- draw_both_dotted.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import . "sngl:draw"

component main {
    canvas(width=100px, height=100px) {
        circle(cx=5.0, cy=5.0, r=2.0)
    }
}
-- draw_names_free.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component rect(label string) {
    text(value=label)
}

component main {
    rect(label="mine")
}
